title: SCAVS
author: Ben Jackson (as David Hunter)
description:
You are one of the lucky ones.

It’s the Scavengers who have the tougher task. They must make their way across a hostile world, avoiding deadly storms, and trying to find enough resources to justify an evac home. You just have to guide them – and keep them alive.

‘System’ tells you not to get friendly – the mission must always come first. But if you choose to listen, you may discover that the Scavenger under your command has their own reasons for being there.

Will you put them at risk in order to achieve the mission, or will you talk to them, find out who they are and why they’re here?

What kind of Operator will you be?


A planet to explore, where your choices will decide the fate of two lives – who may have more in common than they realise.
